_comment: Real D1 REST responses, captured 2026-10-05 against kicad-partlib-staging
(probe P8). These exist so the Store's response unwrapping and error
classification are pinned against what the API actually returns -- if
Cloudflare changes the shape, a test fails loudly rather than a stocktake
Account ids, database ids and tokens have been removed or replaced.
NOTE the http status codes. An earlier version of AGENTS.md claimed a SQL
error comes back as HTTP 200 with success=false. It does not -- it is a
400. That claim was inherited from a design review and never verified;

auth_error._when: a garbage, revoked or expired API token
auth_error._classify_as: D1AuthError -- never retry, nothing was written

sql_error_no_such_table._classify_as: D1SqlError -- never retry, it will fail identically

constraint_violation._when: an INSERT that violates a UNIQUE/PK constraint
constraint_violation._classify_as: D1ConstraintError -- a subclass of D1SqlError. Expected and benign for a plain INSERT retry; the tool uses INSERT OR IGNORE on stock_events so a retried event never reaches this.

multi_statement_with_params_rejected._when: two semicolon-separated statements sent with a shared params array
multi_statement_with_params_rejected._classify_as: D1RequestError -- a programming error, not a runtime one. This is the measured reason the audit row is written by a trigger rather than a second statement: one parameterised statement is the only atomic unit available.

errors.message: The request is malformed: params with multiple statements is not supported

database_not_found._when: a well-formed but unknown database id
database_not_found._classify_as: D1ConfigError -- the secrets file points at the wrong database. Never retry; name the config path.

errors.message: The database 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 could not be found

daily_limit_exceeded: Could not be captured without deliberately burning the account's
100,000 daily row-write budget. Handle it generically: any 4xx whose
message mentions a limit or quota becomes D1LimitError, which must
report progress and name the resume command rather than retrying.
Revisit if it is ever seen in the wild -- and capture it then.
timeout: A client-side socket timeout, so there is no wire body at all. The
Store must classify it from the exception, and it is the one case where
the outcome is genuinely unknown -- hence event_id idempotency and
